marta (infra): Heads-up: rolling NIC soft-reboot + GPU cooldown in az24 tonight 02:00-04:00 UTC. Small cohorts to protect latency pools.
devin: which pools and cohort sizes?
marta (infra): az24-core (8), az24-batch (15), az24-lowlat (5). Drain per cohort: 6m grace + 4m KV reseed + 12m cooldown.
sam.sre: canary on 2 nodes at 02:05. Alert thresholds: p99_api > 220ms or nic_err_rate > 0.6% -> abort.
ops-bot: runbook: https://runbooks.internal/az24-nic-soft. Checklist posts 01:40.
devin: capacity note: az25-burst can absorb batch traffic, estimate cost delta ~800 USD if fully shifted. Recommend partial shift.
marta (infra): we'll partial-shift non-critical batch queues. I'll lower kube-evict grace to 50s during cohorts.
sam.sre: rollback plan: abort routing override, let nodes recover, delay remaining cohorts +1h.
ops-bot: preflight status: nodes healthy, backlog < 900, KV jobs queued. Status: OK.
(01:50) marta (infra): PRE-FLIGHT OK. starting runbook at 01:55.
(02:07) sam.sre: canary green. p99 165ms, nic_err 0.02%. proceeding.
(03:05) marta (infra): mid-check: cohorts 1-4 done, one node had transient rx_drops, replaced, re-seeded, no visible impact.
(03:58) marta (infra): final cohort finished. restoring routes at 03:55 UTC.
(04:10) devin: cost recap: final uplift ~720 USD. Tags applied.
(04:15) ops-bot: maintenance complete. :white_check_mark:
